commit.message: feat(control): add canonical mission control adapter

gates.command: /Users/dhyana/dharma_swarm/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_mission_control.py tests/test_mission_control_mcp.py tests/test_task_board.py tests/test_runtime_state_invariants.py tests/test_mcp_server.py
gates.name: mission-control-contracts

intent: Add one additive Mission Control adapter and MCP read/control surface over the existing TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore owners, without adding a database, registry, scheduler, task ledger, receipt store, agent transport, or authorization bypass. The initial slice proves mission/task/attempt/lease/receipt identity joins, same-process serialized lifecycle mutation, fail-closed observed lease conflicts, receipt-before-task terminal projection, honest crash reconciliation, and read-first MCP access. External control-plane products remain isolated experiments and cannot become canonical state through this packet.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=''.join(x.read_text() for x in [Path('dharma_swarm/mission_control.py'), Path('dharma_swarm/mission_control_contract.py'), Path('dharma_swarm/mission_control_projection.py'), Path('dharma_swarm/mission_control_mcp.py')] if x.exists()); raise SystemExit(1 if ('sqlite3' in p or 'aiosqlite' in p or 'CREATE TABLE' in p) else 0)"
negative_controls.name: no-new-control-store

honest_blockers: This slice does not enroll every live executor; AgentPool, LivingKernel, canonical A2A, and Hermes adapters remain subsequent bounded packets.
This slice does not claim standing supervision, production gateway policy, or external SaaS authentication.
Receipt-backed verification and promotion authority remain separate; Mission Control status alone never authorizes promotion.

RuntimeStateStore has no schema-level one-current-lease-per-task constraint, so this adapter serializes its own process and fails closed on observed conflicts but cannot guarantee exclusivity against bypassing or cross-process writers.

RuntimeStateStore permits direct receipt upserts, so Mission Control detects contradictory or foreign terminal evidence but cannot make owner receipts immutable without a later owner-approved schema change.
interface_mismatches: TaskBoard and RuntimeStateStore use separate SQLite databases, so v0 cannot promise an atomic cross-store lifecycle transition.

RuntimeStateStore allows multiple TaskClaim rows for one task; v0 serializes one adapter process and detects conflicting active claims but cannot provide cross-process concurrency-safe uniqueness without a later owner-approved schema change.
RuntimeStateStore receipt persistence is replaceable rather than append-only; v0 uses the existing idempotency CAS and validates full terminal identity but cannot prevent direct bypassing writers.
The installed MCP SDK is older than the lockfile declaration, so the new server must use only APIs proven by local tests.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the additive Mission Control module, MCP adapter, tests, and this packet. Existing TaskBoard, RuntimeStateStore, A2A, SwarmManager, and runtime state remain untouched.
